mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.5%, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.1 percentage points in one month signals aggressive policy restraint that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp, or the regime-specific Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month signals expanding manufacturing capacity that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 800,000 units, it signals a housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 800.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or the interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 0.5% annualized signals economic deceleration that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate (q/q) < 0.5%, or the regime-specific Rank IC remains below 0.03.
